01 • Our Story

A little bag. A lot of you.

Tote Tales is a student-led, made-to-order personalized canvas tote brand — born at the University of Kamalia. A canvas tote should feel like yours: your name, a quote, a tiny piece of art, or a memory you carry every day.

Made to order — every bag gets full personal attention
1
Student-led & made-to-orderEvery bag is produced after your request — not pulled from stock.
2
Four collectionsQuote, Name, Art and Memory — one easy-to-carry core product.
3
Campus-first serviceUniversity of Kamalia students & the nearby area — order on WhatsApp.
4
Fast 5-day deliveryFull customization, quality check, and delivery in 5 working days.
Our focus: personalization, fair student-friendly prices, careful quality and direct customer feedback.
02 • Why We Exist

The problem is everyday sameness

Many everyday bags look alike, and personal expression is limited. We believe useful things can also be personal.

01

Generic products

Most bags look similar — nothing that says this is mine.

02

Personal meaning

Students want a name, a memorable message or custom artwork — something truly theirs.

03

A durable, repeatedly used bag replaces repeated single-use bag purchases.

not mass inventory

05 • Process

From your idea to your tote — in 5 working days

We never print a name without confirming it first — the process is designed to avoid confusion and give you exactly what you approved.

1

Order

Send your collection, size, colour and text on WhatsApp.

2

Quote

You receive a clear price (PKR 700–2,500) and a 5-day delivery estimate.

3

Approval

Artwork mockup and your consent — before any work begins.

4

Production

A selected maker or printer completes your bag with full customization.

5

QC & Delivery

Finish check, careful packing and handover within 5 working days.

Honest timelines: your delivery date is confirmed on WhatsApp right after you order — we don't promise dates we can't keep.

Payment & trust policies

Before paymentClear size, price and a design preview — always.
Advance / CODDeposit or cash-on-delivery — decided clearly on WhatsApp.
On issueA defined resolution window for defective or wrong designs.
Your dataOnly essential contact info is kept, with restricted access.
